mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 29 degrees and overcast at Verona Community Park under a full moon, with an overnight low of 29 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

Property tax bills will be mailed by December 15. You can pay your taxes online, by mail, or by using the 24-7 drop boxes located at the City Center, where you can also find forms for the lottery credit.

We have a busy week of local events, starting with trivia tonight at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow, yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, or the 50th-anniversary craft beer celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company on Thursday.
On November 2, officers were called to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct following a domestic disturbance.
